Definition: from G1223 and G2065; to question throughout, i.e. ascertain by interrogation:--make enquiry for.
BiblicalUsage: To inquire is to ask after a thing until it is found, and the word stands once, where the men Cornelius sends inquire for Simon's house, asking their way to the gate while Peter wonders within himself what the vision means.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the asking of the men and the wondering of Peter belong together; the men asked their way to the right house, and Peter asked what God meant, and the two questions met at the gate.
